evidence.title: Richard Schoen → André Neves: PhD supervision
evidence.summary: The CIM interview identifies Richard Schoen as supervisor of Neves’s 2005 Stanford PhD.

sources.label: CIM interview with André Neves — doctoral biography

notes: Schoen is represented through his separately verified Stanford emeritus appointment. This does not treat the place of doctoral training as Neves’s current employer. This is a documented historical academic advising relationship. Current institutional affiliations were checked separately; the relationship does not establish admissions committee membership, current contact, letter strength, or willingness to supervise.
